guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows checkoutservice CPU and memory metrics spiked by over 4000% and 1100% respectively (z-scores >231), dwarfing all other services. This severe resource exhaustion in checkoutservice directly explains the upstream frontendservice latency and errors seen in the traces.

proposed_fix.description: Increase CPU and memory resource limits for checkoutservice and restart its pods to clear the exhaustion.
